questions.question: [MOCK] With reference to Eligibility and conditions for taking ITC, which of the following statement(s) is/are correct as per the study material? [variant 1]

options.A: ITC is restricted in proportion of the use of the services and/or services (i) in the taxable and / or zero-rated supplies (ii) for business purposes.
options.B: ITC is restricted in proportion of the use of the goods and/or services (i) in the taxable and / or zero-rated supplies (ii) for business purposes.
options.C: ITC is restricted in proportion of the use of the goods and/or services (i) in the taxable and / or zero-rated supplies (ii) for business purposes except where the recipient is a composition taxpayer.
options.D: ITC is not restricted in proportion of the use of the goods and/or services (i) in the taxable and / or zero-rated supplies (ii) for business purposes.
